name: Capture & Traffic
description: Native tcpdump 4.9.3 capture with validated live interfaces, BPF filters, decode controls, and authenticated PCAP artifacts.
help_text: Operator Mode passes a bounded filter as one argv element, requires native tcpdump BPF compilation before capture, supports decoded text and PCAP output, and preserves the legacy metadata profile for compatibility. Packet replay remains a separate unimplemented action.
